svg.title: Calt Inspired Fixed Forms
svg.desc: A left-right comparison graphic showing 20 Ligconsolata Next samples. The left side is shaped from a smoke-built font with liga, dlig, and calt enabled, and the right side is the same raw ASCII source with ligatures disabled.
svg.text: Low-risk contextual ideas are exposed as stable fixed substitutions.
低风险上下文思路先落成稳定的固定替换。

g.text: Short underscore runs through six cells use fixed glyphs; longer runs use contextual extension.
最多六格的下划线 run 使用固定字形；更长的 run 交给上下文延展。
